correctness.rationale: For all a,b>0 distinct and integer q>=3 at lattice translation 1, modulation 1/q, exact q-residue Zak grouping gives a q-fold sum of |P_j(x,z)|^2 with positive affine numerator and denominator factors decreasing in Re(z), so min frequency z=-1 and max z=1. At z=1 spatial positive-exponential sums have strictly convex squares and periodic equal endpoint values, maximizing at integer x. At z=-1 differentiating the quadratic in e^{(a+b)x} gives b V t^2+(a-b)W t-a U=0, exactly one positive root interior, yielding A. Nonproportional u,v ensure UV>W² and A>0. Numerical checks independently summed bilateral Zak series for four slope/redundancy parameter sets, comparing exact A/B and checking a 9x9 phase grid; equal-rate case also tested only as a consistency check. These checks are not a proof for all a,b,q.
